anomalies.observed: On the Microcontroller sheet the WS2812B status LED D11 has its data input (DIN) wired to a short wire that terminates in the global label NET0004. Tracing every global label on the ESP32-C3-MINI-1 (U4) shows the MCU carries NET0002, NET0003, NET0006, NET0007, NET0009, NET0010, NET0012, NET0013, NET0014, NET0018 and NET0019, but NET0004 appears nowhere on U4 (and nowhere else in the design). The LED data line is therefore a one-member net with no driver.
anomalies.expected: The specification states the board drives 'a single onboard WS2812B status LED (D1)' and the firmware (led.rs) sets its color per run state, so D11.DIN must be connected to an ESP32 GPIO. The reference design's D1 data line is MCU-driven; here it is left floating.
